tw-wi-beaver-mattrick-farm-1925.st: Treasure websites retell this as 'Battaglan stolen silver near Beaver Lake, Sawyer County'; that is this case misplaced: the farm is in the town of Beaver, Marinette County, and the money was in glass jars in a keg under the basement potatoes.
src: Stevens Point Journal, 17 Oct 1924, p. 1 ($11,200 in glass jars in a basement keg; couple charged)
